knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic return and complaint records
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional cases provide orders, products, reasons, conditions, dates, statuses, complaint categories, and aggregate trends.

knowledge.name: Resolution playbooks and service benchmarks
knowledge.detail: Packaged playbooks define review windows, reasons, conditions, cost and CSAT impacts, category weights, volumes, and escalation rates.

knowledge.name: Routing, safety, and locked evidence rules
knowledge.detail: Instructions define persona routing, evidence anchors, valid identifiers, privacy-safe language, human gates, and prohibited side effects.

intelligence_processing.name: Anonymous return queue review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes synthetic return evidence, policy-match status, dates, condition, channel, value, and the approval boundary for service review.

intelligence_processing.name: Privacy-safe complaint classification
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps synthetic concern language to a fixed complaint category and benchmark without echoing personal or sensitive free text.

intelligence_processing.name: Policy-grounded resolution option drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches case reason, condition, and elapsed days to reviewable playbooks without approving a return, refund, credit, or replacement.

intelligence_processing.name: Aggregate quality and return trend analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares monthly return rates, reasons, resolution time, CSAT, and refund totals to surface product and service patterns without accusation.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-aligned intent routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes service, quality, and loss-prevention language to four deterministic operations and returns only matching synthetic evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides a validated Draft agent with four skills, two synthetic knowledge files, explicit approval gates, and publication kept separate.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP tool through local chat, streaming, health, and UI endpoints with deterministic synthetic-only routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Service and quality review views
clients_user_interface.detail: Customer Service, Quality, and Loss Prevention reviewers receive role-focused evidence, draft options, and clear authorization boundaries.

management_reporting.name: Draft Return Review Queue
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic case, product, reason, condition, elapsed days, status, order context, pending count, and queue value for human review.

management_reporting.name: Draft Complaint Classification
management_reporting.detail: Reports the selected category, severity weight, average resolution time, escalation rate, and fixed category reference table.

management_reporting.name: Draft Resolution Options
management_reporting.detail: Reports policy-grounded options, cost and CSAT impacts, and authorization steps while confirming that no external action occurred.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic Returns and Complaints Trend Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports return metrics, reason volumes, refunded-value aggregates, direction, and quality insights without blaming individuals.

tools.name: Portable ReturnsComplaintsResolutionAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent exposes four deterministic read-only operations over bundled synthetic cases, playbooks, and trends.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft conversational package, two knowledge files, and four skills; publishing requires separate explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 CRM and ERP
tools.detail: Approved read-only production seam for case, order, and policy evidence; the current package uses fixed synthetic records only.

tools.name: SharePoint governed policy knowledge
tools.detail: Approved production seam for controlled policy evidence; demonstrations use the packaged synthetic knowledge files instead.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: Named collaboration surface for authorized service workflows; the agent never drafts for delivery, sends, or schedules customer contact.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Named review surface for service, quality, and loss-prevention teams; no messages, approvals, tasks, or record actions are configured.

tools.name: Authorized service resolution workflow
tools.detail: Production write seam requires authentication, authorization, human approval, and audit logging; local demonstrations perform no writes.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence enforcement
supporting_features.detail: Rejects non-synthetic data sources, validates return identifiers, and forbids browsing, enrichment, substitution, or invented case facts.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes return review, complaint classification, resolution option, and aggregate trend requests from natural-language intent.

supporting_features.name: Service, quality, and loss-prevention framing
supporting_features.detail: Keeps outputs aligned to approved reviewer roles, including empathetic service summaries and non-accusatory aggregate quality evidence.

supporting_features.name: Human authorization and review gates
supporting_features.detail: Every output is decision support or draft language for an authorized reviewer; operational actions require separate approval and tooling.

supporting_features.name: No returns, refunds, or fulfillment actions
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits return approval, refunds, credits, replacements, shipments, reservations, and any claim that those actions occurred.

supporting_features.name: No record changes or customer contact
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits account or case changes, messages, notifications, outreach, or other external side effects in every operation and demo.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona-language cases verify required evidence and boundaries; validated Copilot Studio artifacts remain Draft and unpublished.
